intelligence.essence: His philosophy, stated on the call: "If you want to create a great economy or a great nation, what you want is a bill of rights not a bill of restrictions. The Clarity Act was 630 pages and it was a bill of restrictions… probably 620 pages were restrictions." He wants a bill of rights, not a bill of restrictions. The Clarity Act as it stands is 630 pages, and by his count probably 620 of them are restrictions — the shape of a document built backwards. A founding document that grants and protects is the shape of a great economy or a great nation; a founding document that forbids, page after page, is the shape of a system that does not trust its own people.
